cards.text: Jesus, the Christ, has been out teaching and preaching from town to town (Matthew 11:1). Meanwhile John the Baptist, the man who baptized crowds in the Jordan River (Matthew 3:5-6), is in prison. From in there he hears about the works of Christ, and friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer, so I KNOW what it's like being stuck while everything happens out there.

cards.question: John can't walk out of prison to see Jesus for himself. Who does he send to Jesus with a question?
John's disciples reach Jesus with John's question. What does John want to know?

answers.text: If Jesus is the One who was to come
If Jesus will come to the prison
If Jesus will pray for him

cards.text: Jesus doesn't just hand them a yes. He tells John's disciples, "Go back and report to John what you hear and see:"

The report starts like this: the blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, and Jesus is NOT done yet. John sent a yes or no question, and Jesus is sending back a WHOLE highlight reel.

cards.question: True or false: part of Jesus' report for John is that the dead are raised.
In that same report for John, Jesus says the good news is preached to the ___.
Jesus ends His message for John with a blessing. Who is the blessing for?

answers.text: Whoever doesn't fall away because of Him
Whoever gives up everything for Him
Whoever keeps watch through the night

cards.text: As John's disciples are leaving, Jesus starts talking to the crowds about John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?" You walked ALL the way out into the wilderness... to watch a plant wave?

cards.question: Next, Jesus asks the crowds if they went out to see a man dressed in fine clothes. Jesus says people who wear fine clothing are found in ___.
Then Jesus asks the crowds if they went out to see a prophet. True or false: Jesus says John is a prophet and nothing more.
Jesus quotes Malachi 3:1 and says John is the one it's about: a messenger sent on ahead. That messenger is sent to ___ the way.
Jesus keeps talking to the crowds about John. True or false: Jesus says no one born of women has risen greater than John the Baptist.
Then Jesus says there is someone greater than John. Who does He say that is?

answers.text: The least in the kingdom of heaven
The prophets who came before him

cards.text: Jesus says that from the days of John the Baptist until now, "the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it."

cards.question: Then Jesus says all the Prophets and the Law prophesied up until a certain man. Who?

cards.text: Then Jesus tells the crowds that if they're willing to accept it, John is the Elijah who was to come. That's Elijah, a prophet of Israel from long before John.
Jesus says, "He who has ears, let him hear." Then He asks what He can compare this generation to, and He paints a marketplace scene: someone calling out to others to play along, and NOBODY will.

cards.question: In Jesus' marketplace picture of this generation, who is sitting there calling out to others to play along?

cards.text: The children call out, "We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn." Friend, that's me baking chocolate chip, then sprinkles, then butterscotch, and the SAME guy won't touch ANY of it, so at some point... it's not the cookie.

cards.question: Jesus says John came neither eating nor drinking. What do people say about John?
Then Jesus, the Son of Man, came eating and drinking. True or false: this time, the people finally approve.

cards.text: They say, "Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!" And Jesus ends with this: "But wisdom is vindicated by her actions."
